parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$(x-2)^2<5$ gives $-\sqrt5<x-2<\sqrt5$ and/or $|x-2|<\sqrt5$. — M1. Guidance: allow $x-2<\pm\sqrt5$, $x-2=\pm\sqrt5$, and decimal equivalents; follow through from part (i); also allow $\sqrt{13}$ instead of $\sqrt5$ for a clear slip.
$2-\sqrt5<x<2+\sqrt5$. — A1A1. Guidance: A1 for each inequality; allow two separate statements but there must be two inequalities for $x$. A completely correct non-hence method scores SC 1/3.
Total: 3
